coherence_floor.statement: On real Qwen3.8 activations (256 tokens, 6 layers, holdout 64), the cheap-to-reconstruct coherence floor is uniform-q3 at 3.25 BPW. No cheap in-register codec is both below 2.0 BPW and quality-intact.

next_cheap_rung.note: gate/up/attn_in stay >=0.90; L63 down_proj is the first organ to dip (0.843).

below_2p0_requires: a 1-bit organ (binary) on substantial mass — quality NOT intact at mid-depth
or a structured codec (HGRAVS01 two-stage on the wide down_proj, 0.13 BPW)
rice residual is a small quality bump over binary (~+0.04) and a reconstruction regression risk
coherence_floor.q30_warning: Q30 lost coherence at <=1.5 BPW. binary_all at 1.42 is in that graveyard zone.
coherence_floor.capture_limit: 256 tokens / 64 holdout. Organ cosine is a screen; generation is the gate. attn_out in-dim is 6144 and was weight-scored only.

findings.density_without_reconstruct_cost: Qwen3.8 is bandwidth-bound at 406 GB/s. Cheap affine/sign-scale/ternary keep the invariant ms = 33.537 * (bpw/4.2527). Expensive rice/lowrank-as-reconstruct do not.
findings.q80_lesson_applied: A codec that halves bytes and triples reconstruction is a regression. Rice-priced at Q80's 5.9x/byte turns the sibling 2.09 BPW pack into ~21 TPS, worse than today's 29.8.
findings.lowrank_is_different_on_dense: Q80 expert 512x2048 at rank 160 is 31% of rows. Qwen3.8 down 5120x17408 at rank 160 is 3.1% of rows = 0.13 BPW. Consumed as L@(R@x) this is CHEAP algebra, not Q80's reconstruction wall.
findings.no_never_routed_rows: Every dense row has real activations. Weight-space SVD fallback was not used. down_proj scored on real post-SwiGLU X.
findings.ternary_beats_q2: At identical 2.25 BPW, ternary hold means are 0.90–0.93 vs affine-q2 0.82–0.87. Hadamard-q2 is worse than both.
findings.binary_is_not_free: binary_g128 is the cheapest reconstruct (sign*scale) but mid-depth up/down hold 0.73–0.79. L63 gate/up look easy (0.95+) and must not be averaged into a pass.
findings.sibling_not_duplicated: Did not write mixed-2p0-v1, did not generalise the Q80 packer, did not run generation on the sibling artifact.

candidate_table_note: projected_ms_token uses the byte-count invariant (penalty=1). cost_adjusted applies the stated recon_penalty. Ranked by (4.2527-bpw)/ms_adj.
